examples.translation: Advertising is not the same as the actual [thing].

examples.sentence: 广告说得好，实际上不一定好。
examples.romanization: guǎnggào shuō dé hǎo， shíjìshàng bùyīdìng hǎo。
examples.translation: The advertisement is well said, but it is not necessarily good in reality.

title: 对……来说 (for, as for)
longExplanation: for, as for. Pinyin: duì…… láishuō

examples.sentence: 对我来说，学习机会更重要。
examples.translation: For me, learning opportunities are more important.

examples.romanization: nín nǚ'ér zhǎngde tèbié xiàng nín。
examples.translation: Your daughter looks especially like you.

examples.sentence: 您女儿长得真像您，特别是/尤其眼睛。
examples.romanization: nín nǚ'ér zhǎngde zhēn xiàng nín， tèbié shì/ yóuqí yǎnjing。
examples.translation: Your daughter looks like you, especially her eyes.

examples.romanization: wǒ yǒu yī gè tèbié de yāoqiú。

examples.sentence: 这个歌特别好听，最近很流行，你竟然没听过？
examples.romanization: zhège gē tèbié hǎotīng， zuìjìn hěn liúxíng， nǐ jìngrán méi tīng guò？
examples.translation: This song is particularly nice, it has been very popular recently, you’re telling me you’ve never heard of it?

examples.romanization: èr de wǔ bèi shì shí。

examples.sentence: 您看看这个，不管从价格方面看， 还是从质量上看， 都是值得考虑的。
examples.romanization: nín kànkan zhège， bùguǎn cóng jiàgé fāngmiàn kàn， háishi cóng zhìliàng shàng kàn， dōu shì zhíde kǎolǜ de。
examples.translation: Look at this, both in terms of price and quality, it is worth considering.

title: 值/值得 (is worth it)
longExplanation: is worth it. Pinyin: zhí/ zhíde

examples.sentence: 别总是为一点儿小事生气，不值/值得。
examples.romanization: bié zǒngshì wéi yīdiǎnr xiǎoshì shēngqì， bùzhí/ zhíde。
examples.translation: Don't always be angry with a little thing, it’s not worth it.
This watch is worth fifty yuan.

examples.sentence: 我们不仅要会读书，还要会选择其中的好书来读。
examples.romanization: wǒmen bùjǐn yào huì dúshū， hái yào huì xuǎnzé qízhōng de hǎo shū lái dú。
examples.translation: Not only do we have to read books, but we also need to know how to choose the good ones among them to read.

title: (在) SITUATION 下 (under SITUATION)
longExplanation: under SITUATION. Pinyin: ( zài) SITUATION xià

examples.sentence: (在) 一般情况下，你花的钱越多，买的东西也就越好。
examples.romanization: ( zài) yībān qíngkuàng xià， nǐ huā de qián yuè duō， mǎi de dōngxi yě jiù yuè hǎo。
examples.translation: In general (lit. under general circumstances), the more money you spend, the better the goods you buy.

title: 估计/可能 CLAUSE (perhaps CLAUSE)
longExplanation: perhaps CLAUSE. Pinyin: gūjì/ kěnéng CLAUSE

examples.sentence: 你有没有去问问小王？估计/可能他应该有办法。
examples.romanization: nǐ yǒu méiyǒu qù wèn wèn xiǎo wáng？ gūjì/ kěnéng tā yīnggāi yǒubànfǎ。
examples.translation: Have you asked Xiao Wang? Perhaps he should have a solution.

title: 估计/可能 V (perhaps V)
longExplanation: perhaps V. Pinyin: gūjì/ kěnéng V

examples.sentence: 我还不习惯北方的气候，估计/可能是天气太干。
examples.romanization: wǒ hái bù xíguàn běifāng de qìhòu， gūjì/ kěnéng shì tiānqì tài gàn。
examples.translation: I am not used to the climate in the north. Perhaps it’s because the weather is too dry.
